sloka: शार्दूल यदि सा दृष्टा प्रिया चंद्र निभ आनना ।मैथिली मम विस्रब्धम् कथयस्व न ते भयम् ॥३-६०-२५॥
transliteration: śārdūla yadi sā dṛṣṭā priyā caṁdra nibha ānanā ।maithilī mama visrabdham kathayasva na te bhayam ॥3-60-25॥

translations.english: O tiger tell me freely and fearlessly if you have seen my beloved princess from Mithila with a face like the moon.
